hook: Sixty-eight boxes of private diaries reveal the hidden mind of Dame A.S. Byatt.

sections.voiceover: Sixty-eight boxes of private diaries reveal the hidden mind of Dame A.S. Byatt.
sections.visual_cue: Close up shot of stacked cardboard archive boxes in a dim institutional room

sections.voiceover: The British Library acquired her entire literary archive spanning six decades of writing. Dame A.S. Byatt passed away in 2023 at the age of 87. What does a September 1956 diary entry tell us about her early life?
sections.visual_cue: Archivist hands opening an old leather bound journal on a wooden table

sections.voiceover: Except the British Library holds her September 1956 diary entry from when she was twenty years old.
sections.visual_cue: Panning shot across handwritten ink pages with marginal notes

sections.voiceover: That September 1956 diary entry captures Dame A.S. Byatt at twenty years old.
sections.visual_cue: Wide shot of rows of archival shelving in a climate controlled vault

sections.voiceover: All sixty-eight boxes successfully preserve her extraordinary literary legacy today.
sections.visual_cue: Static frame of a single archive box label reading A.S. Byatt
